question: Under the EU AI Act, besides safety components of products covered by Annex I, which other AI systems are classified as high-risk?
answer: Under the EU AI Act, besides safety components of products covered by Annex I, stand-alone AI systems that are themselves products are also classified as high-risk. This is because the classification of an AI system as high-risk pursuant to this Regulation should not necessarily mean that the product whose safety component is the AI system, or the AI system itself as a product, is considered to be high-risk under the criteria established in the relevant Union harmonisation legislation that applies to the product. (doc=eu, page=14)
